metadata.purpose: dates, captions, and last edited text.

navigation.purpose: 16px navigation, reduced to 15px and 14px at the mobile breakpoints.

motion.name: link-color
motion.purpose: link hover transition; disabled for reduced motion on reading pages.

components.name: Reading Navigation
components.description: Muted, unadorned site links on reading pages.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:18px; font-family:Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; } .ds-nav a { color:#8a8a8a; text-decoration:none; transition:color 220ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#787878; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #d8d4c8; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Project List Entry
components.description: A project title and first-commit date, with a muted description below.
components.html:
orbit-accessdec 13, 2025

simulate satellite orbits and find ground-station visibility windows.
components.css: .ds-entry { font-family:Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-entry a { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:baseline; gap:24px; color:#d8d4c8; padding-block:8px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-entry a:hover { color:#787878; } .ds-entry span { overflow-wrap:anywhere; text-decoration:none; } .ds-entry time { color:#8a8a8a; font-size:12px; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-entry p { margin:0; color:#8a8a8a; font-size:14px; line-height:1.6; }

components.name: Project Code Block
components.description: An inset code sample that scrolls horizontally when needed.
components.css: .ds-code { max-width:100%; overflow-x:auto; margin:0; padding:16px; background:#121210; border:1px solid #252522; color:#d8d4c8; font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; }

narrative.overview: the site is a sparse, dark reading surface. its interface steps aside for brief personal text, dated indexes, and static project readmes. links omit underlines throughout the site; social icons sit above more: essays, projects.
keyCharacteristics: dark surface with cream reading text and muted navigation or metadata.
unadorned links and no decorative containers.
static project pages that preserve readme structure.

rules.name: The Quiet Palette Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary page content within the dark, cream, and muted-gray system. Reserve orange for text selection.

dos: Do use the local inter font and the established type scale.
Do keep index and project reading columns at 680px maximum width.
Do use muted text for navigation, dates, descriptions, captions, and project metadata.
Do omit link underlines throughout the site and use the darker grey hover state.
Do keep project images local and responsive, and external github links in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer".
donts: Don't add browser-side rendering scripts for project content.
Don't replace the flat reading surface with cards, shadows, gradients, or decorative color.
Don't let long code expand the page width; preserve internal horizontal scrolling.
